Tightens the request guard on OpenCode 2 so every Tinfoil request is verified and encrypted to the enclave before it is sent, including when the config has a `providers.tinfoil` entry or another plugin changes the provider's package or transport. A request that cannot go through the guard is refused instead of sent.

Upgrade an existing OpenCode 2 installation:

```sh
opencode plugin update @tinfoilsh/opencode-provider
opencode service restart
```

Validated on OpenCode 2.0.30 with provider config overrides, plugins that change the package or transport, and failing attestation.

Via #10.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/tinfoilsh/opencode-provider/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3)

Adds OpenCode 2 support while retaining compatibility with OpenCode 1.19.1+ (1.x).

- Supports OpenCode 2.0.30+, including the provider, verification sidebar, and `/tinfoil` dialog.
- Preserves verified, encrypted inference with saved credentials or `TINFOIL_API_KEY` on both versions.
- Stops OpenCode 2 retries when enclave verification fails and prevents idle OpenCode 1 instances from overwriting the active verification status.

Install on OpenCode 2:

```sh
opencode plugin add @tinfoilsh/opencode-provider
```

Upgrade an existing OpenCode 2 installation:

```sh
opencode plugin update @tinfoilsh/opencode-provider
opencode service restart
```

For OpenCode 1.x:

```sh
opencode plugin @tinfoilsh/opencode-provider --global
```

Validated on OpenCode 1.19.1 and 2.0.30 with package installation, live encrypted inference, tool calls, verification failure blocking, and both TUIs. OpenCode 2's background service was also checked before and after a restart.

Fixes #8 via #9.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/tinfoilsh/opencode-provider/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2)
